messages:
Maya (Account Exec): FYI WellBridge legal submitted a short vendor checklist. They want a SIG/CAIQ subset filled, an LOA that scopes the POC controls, and confirmation on KMS for the trial. Also asked: can we run POC on Hosted for speed or do they need Dedicated for isolation?

Luis (Security): Short answer: Hosted = fastest but uses Redwood-managed keys. Dedicated supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) with an envelope key pattern. Private/VPC supports HSM. For a security review, customer-managed KMS on Dedicated meets the typical control ask.

Rina (Solutions): I can assemble: LOA one-pager, SIG subset responses (plain English), network and dataflow diagram, subprocessors list, redacted audit screenshots. ETA: LOA + SIG subset = 1 business day (tight); full evidence bundle = 3 business days. Dedicated trial provisioning ~48-96 hrs after PO.

Tom (SalesOps): Pricing options for POC: Hosted trial credits (up to 500k tokens) or Dedicated trial: discounted flat rate $900/day for a small pool (2-3 GPUs). We can offer setup fee waiver for trials with BO signed. BYOK requirement => Dedicated pricing applies. I can issue a provisional quote once scope confirmed.

Maya (Account Exec): WellBridge asked specifically: 1) "Do logs contain original prompt text by default?" 2) "Can LOA explicitly exclude HR and long-term retention controls for a scoped POC?"

Luis (Security): Logs: by default we store request metadata and short-lived payload traces for debugging. For Hosted we do not persist full prompts unless enabled; for Dedicated you control retention and can ship logs to their SIEM (syslog/s3). LOA: yes we can explicitly list excluded controls for the POC (eg. A.7 HR, A.8 physical access, A.5 supplier gov). We'll call out included controls like access control, crypto, change mgmt.

Rina (Solutions): LOA draft (very short):

"Letter of Applicability or POC (WellBridge)"
- POC scope: Redwood Dedicated trial pool (ephemeral) used only for WellBridge POC.
- In-scope controls: access control, cryptography (encryption in transit + at rest), logging & monitoring (short retention), patching & vuln mgmt for POC hosts.
- Out-of-scope controls: HR onboarding/offboarding, company-wide physical security, long-term record retention.
- Evidence: SIG subset answers, network diagram, KMS config snippet, subprocessors list, sample audit extracts.

Rina (Solutions): Example KMS snippet for their infra team:

```yaml
kms:
  provider: gcp-kms
  key_name: "projects/wb-poc/locations/global/keyRings/wb-ring/cryptoKeys/wb-poc-key"
  customer_managed: true
  usage_scope: "dedicated-poc-pool"
```

Rina (Solutions): Note: we support an ephemeral alias flow where the key is granted only for the POC timeframe. Luis will need to sign off on the addendum.

Tom (SalesOps): Uploaded a provisional quote + POC T&Cs to the deal workspace: https://redwood.internal/sales/deals/WB-456/quote (internal link). If they confirm BYOK + 10-day window we can reduce daily rate.

evidence-bot: Evidence request created: EVID-5221. Assignee: Luis (Security). Attachments: LOA_wellbridge_v1.docx, SIG_subset.csv.

Maya (Account Exec): Customer follow-up: they want the SIG answers in plain English (not just yes/no). Can we do a short paragraph per item?

Luis (Security): Yes. I'll produce plain-English answers for the ~10 SIG questions relevant to confidentiality, crypto, logging, and subprocessors. ETA: 2 business days.

Rina (Solutions): Also ask WellBridge to confirm concurrency and whether they will send any PHI. If PHI is in scope, we need Private deployment and different legal terms.

Maya (Account Exec): They confirmed synthetic data only, low concurrency (~20 rps). BYOK required. Sounds like Dedicated fits. I'll confirm test dates.

Tom (SalesOps): Once BYOK confirmed I'll finalize the Dedicated trial quote and mark setup as expedited. Please CC me on the customer reply.

Luis (Security): I'll prepare LOA + SIG plain-English answers and attach the control mapping. If procurement asks for certs/cert chain we'll escalate to security-eng.

Rina (Solutions): I can also draft a short runbook for their infra team (BYOK steps, kube creds, sample client) and a pared-down test plan.

Maya (Account Exec): Next steps: 1) Luis: LOA + SIG answers (1-2 days) or EVID-5221 2) Tom: finalize Dedicated quote after BYOK confirmation 3) Rina: runbook + evidence exports. I'll update WellBridge tonight.

Tom (SalesOps): On it.

Luis (Security): Starting LOA/SIG work.

Rina (Solutions): Will prep runbook.

Maya (Account Exec): Thanks team :handshake:
